name: coalesce-serve-vscode
description: Run `coa serve` in the background and open the Coalesce UI in an editor tab instead of an external browser.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Serve this Coalesce workspace locally and open the UI in an editor tab.

[$(play) Open Coalesce UI](command:coalesceServe.open)

The server is started with `coa serve --no-open` and is stopped again when you close the tab.

The local Coalesce UI is running.

[$(preview) Show tab](command:coalesceServe.open)
[$(debug-restart) Restart](command:coalesceServe.restart)
[$(debug-stop) Stop](command:coalesceServe.stop)
[$(output) Show log](command:coalesceServe.showLog)

commands.title: Coalesce: Show Local UI Server Log

coalesceServe.coaPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `coa` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect: the Coalesce Desktop shim (`~/.coalesce/desktop/coa`) is preferred, otherwise `coa` from `PATH`.

coalesceServe.port.description: Preferred port for `coa serve`. If it is already taken, the next free port is used.

coalesceServe.workspaceFolder.description: Workspace folder (name or absolute path) to serve. Leave empty to use the folder containing data.yml, or the first folder.

coalesceServe.showStatusBarItem.description: Show a status bar item while the local UI server is running.
